claude_flow.title: Email + password: sign up and log in
claude_flow.flowchart:
flowchart TD
  Start((Open app)) --> HasAcct{Have an account?}
  HasAcct -->|no| S1
  HasAcct -->|yes| L1

  subgraph signup [Sign up]
    S1[Enter email and password] --> S2{Email and password valid?}
    S2 -->|no| S3[Show field errors]
    S3 --> S1
    S2 -->|yes| S4{Email already registered?}
    S4 -->|yes| S5[Email owner: you already have an account]
    S4 -->|no| S6[Hash password, save unverified account]
    S6 --> S7[Email a verification link]
    S5 --> S8[Show: check your inbox]
    S7 --> S8
    S8 --> S9{Link opened and still valid?}
    S9 -->|no, expired| S10[Resend link]
    S10 --> S8
    S9 -->|yes| S11[Mark email verified]
  end

  subgraph login [Log in]
    L1[Enter email and password] --> L2{Too many attempts?}
    L2 -->|yes| L3[Wait, then try again]
    L3 --> L1
    L2 -->|no| L4{Email and password match?}
    L4 -->|no| L5[Show: wrong email or password]
    L5 -->|retry| L1
    L4 -->|yes| L6{Email verified?}
    L6 -->|yes| L7[Create session]
  end

  subgraph reset [Forgot password]
    R1[Enter email] --> R2[Show: if the account exists, we sent a link]
    R2 --> R3{Link opened and still valid?}
    R3 -->|no, expired| R1
    R3 -->|yes| R4[Set new password]
    R4 --> R5[Sign out all other sessions]
  end

  L5 -->|forgot password| R1
  L6 -->|no| S10
  S11 --> L1
  R5 --> L1
  L7 --> Home((Signed in))

codex_1.title: Proposed template selection → usable workdesk
codex_1.flowchart:
flowchart TD
subgraph discover [1. Find a template]
 A([New workdesk]) --> B["Choose a starting point"]
 B -->|From template| C["Template gallery: search, categories, preview cards"]
 B -->|Start blank| Z([Open empty workdesk])
 C --> D["Template preview: canvas, purpose, included files and tools, setup needed"]
 D -->|Back to gallery| C
 C -->|No results| E["Clear filters or start blank"]
 E --> C
 E --> Z
end
subgraph create [2. Make your copy]
 D -->|Use template| F["Create workdesk: suggested name and destination folder"]
 F -->|Cancel| D
 F --> G{"Name and folder valid?"}
 G -->|No| H["Show field error; keep entered values"]
 H --> F
 G -->|Yes: Create workdesk| I["Creating your workdesk: copy layout, files and template instructions"]
 I --> J{"Copy created?"}
 J -->|No| K["Explain failure; preserve choices; retry without duplicates"]
 K --> I
end
subgraph use [3. Start using it]
 J -->|Yes| L["Open the new workdesk: show starter guide and first action"]
 L --> M{"Required setup remaining?"}
 M -->|Yes| N["Setup checklist: choose project folder, connect accounts, fill required inputs"]
 N --> O{"Ready to run?"}
 O -->|Not yet| P["Keep workdesk editable; show what is needed for blocked actions"]
 P --> N
 O -->|Yes| Q["User starts the first task"]
 M -->|No| Q
 Q --> R([Workdesk ready to use])
end
 I -.-> S["Copy rule: independent workdesk; preserve source template; exclude secrets, live sessions and running tasks"]

codex_3.title: Template selection — simplified flow
codex_3.flowchart:
flowchart TD
 A([New workdesk]) --> B[Browse templates]
 B --> C[Preview selected template]
 C -->|Use template| D[Name workdesk and choose folder]
 D -->|Create workdesk| E[Clone template]
 E --> F[Open your new workdesk]
 F --> G[Complete required setup]
 G --> H([Start first task])
 B -->|No matches| X[Clear search or start blank]
 D -->|Invalid input| Y[Show inline error and keep values]
 E -->|Copy failed| Z[Keep choices and offer Retry]
 G -->|Nothing required| W([Ready immediately])

opencode.title: Auth database
opencode.flowchart:
flowchart TB
  U["USERS · id PK · email UNIQUE · password_hash · email_verified · status · failed_attempts · locked_until · created_at · updated_at"]
  S["SESSIONS · id PK · user_id FK · token_hash UNIQUE · created_at · expires_at · ip · user_agent · revoked_at"]
  T["AUTH_TOKENS · id PK · user_id FK · token_hash · type: verify/reset · expires_at · used_at · created_at"]
  A["LOGIN_AUDIT · id PK · user_id FK · email · ip · success · created_at"]
  P["PROFILES · user_id PK/FK · display_name · avatar_url · timezone"]
  R["ROLES · id PK · name UNIQUE"]
  UR["USER_ROLES · user_id FK · role_id FK"]

  U -->|"1 : N"| S
  U -->|"1 : N"| T
  U -->|"1 : N"| A
  U -->|"1 : 1"| P
  U -->|"1 : N"| UR
  R -->|"1 : N"| UR
